args.title: Brightline Freight: Cold-chain logistics in 2026 (article + companion)
args.body:
- Temperature excursions fell 30% where carriers shared live sensor data (Brightline Freight, "Cold-chain logistics in 2026").
- Most of the savings came from fewer rejected loads, not from less spoilage.
- Companion piece: pilots cut claims by a quarter.

Sources:
- Article: https://blog.brightline.example/2026/cold-chain
- Companion: https://insights.brightline.example/cold-chain/companion
